memory_semantics_scope: One synchronous address, read-old-data plus optional write each master edge. No reset clear/initialization/loader/second-master port. Resource-only implementation: new RAM wrapper not functionally simulated, no physical IO or ready/valid contract. One-cycle structural read latency is not board service guarantee.

capacity_scenario_limit: Arithmetic only; ports, widths, duplication and metadata can change block use. SNES VRAM cache from004 is not automatically FPGA M9K. No packet/cache size adopted.
integration_verdict: Minimum fits; complete system feasibility remains open. 12281LE and881/963LABs imply packing/routing risk. R2 workload determines remaining hardware before R1 can close.
